purpose: Resolve WRONG_METADATA (observability-1.json) and record the two Engine strings ARMS's FIDELITY.md quotes for the COMP arm parameters.
method: curl -sL https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/changelog (HTTP 200, 1588756 bytes, sha256 of the HTML ae06ea5fcdaf9a254fed0245914fb86b7a7cb469ddbf9f5ab296e2caf9826f17); HTML tags stripped, headings and entries read in document order over the whole page (not only the first 100k characters). passages.heading: October 5-12, 2026
passages.quote: Engine now watches CI on the pull requests it opens for your issues and, when checks fail on its own commits, automatically pushes a revision that reproduces the failing checks and fixes them, up to three revisions or 90 minutes per chain.
passages.contains: up to three revisions or 90 minutes per chain

passages.heading: October 5-12, 2026
passages.quote: Issue validation now replays each source run against its fix preview deployment, so a validation no longer fails when the original run used non-chat input, checkpoint state, or agent-type configuration that trace-only chat reconstruction could not reproduce.
passages.contains: replays each source run against its fix preview deployment

passages.heading: September 14-21, 2026
passages.quote: Engine now reads the contents of successful tool results rather than only their status, so it files issues where a call returned less data than its own result claims or where a value arrived truncated. Defects that never surface as an error are no longer passed over.
passages.contains: reads the contents of successful tool results
